owner_signature_observable.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from an AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derivable_flag.meaning: an adversary can derive a high-s counterpart of a valid owner signature via s' = secp256k1_order - s and v' = v XOR 1 whose recovered address equals the original signer

signature_mismatch_present.meaning: the submitted UserOp signature does not match the expected owner signature (signature mismatch condition)

sig_validation_failed_returned.meaning: validateUserOp returns SIG_VALIDATION_FAILED (1) without reverting on signature mismatch
sig_validation_failed_returned.checkpoint: at validateUserOp return on signature mismatch

validate_userop_reverts.meaning: validateUserOp reverts during bundler simulation of the griefing UserOp
validate_userop_reverts.checkpoint: during bundler simulation of the griefing UserOp

assumptions: The griefing UserOp is submitted to an AtomWallet whose owner signature is observable on-chain.
The derived high-s signature recovers to the same owner address as the original signature, producing a signature mismatch under validation.
Bundler simulation executes validateUserOp for the griefing UserOp.

unresolved.description: Report describes the bundler simulation failure as potential/conditional and does not state whether the griefing UserOp was actually observed on-chain.

limitations: Formalizes only the bundler_simulation_failure impact; retry/blacklist, batch failure, and wallet degradation are separate impacts not covered here.
Gas/compute waste amounts are not quantified in the report and are not encoded.
EntryPoint version and bundler implementation are unspecified; the plan binds the report-level simulation-revert observable only.
